steps.title: Thaw and expand Expi293F cells
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen Expi293F cells, culture them for at least one week, and maintain them in Expi293F expression media at 37 °C, 8 % CO₂, shaking at 125 rpm.

steps.title: Assess cell viability and count
steps.instruction: Take an aliquot of the culture, dilute 10‑fold with PBS (100 µL cells + 900 µL PBS), mix 10 µL diluted cells with 10 µL trypan blue, and count viable cells using a hemocytometer or automated counter; viability must be >95 %.

steps.title: Seed cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Calculate the total number of cells needed (e.g., 3 × 10⁵ cells per sample × (6 concentrations + 3 controls) × 2 replicates = 5.4 × 10⁶ cells; add 1.5× overage → ≥8.1 × 10⁶ cells). Seed cells at 2.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL in enough volume (e.g., 4 mL for 18 samples) in a shaking incubator (37 °C, 8 % CO₂, 125 rpm).

steps.title: Prepare DNA and transfection reagents
steps.instruction: For each mL of culture prepare: 0.5 µg pEGFP plasmid, 0.5 µg pWT‑SARS‑2 plasmid (DNA concentration ≥1 µg/mL, endotoxin‑removed, 0.2 µm sterile‑filtered), 60 µL OptiMEM for DNA dilution, 60 µL OptiMEM for ExpiFectamine dilution, and 3.2 µL ExpiFectamine 293. Example for 4 mL: 2 µg each plasmid, 240 µL OptiMEM (DNA), 240 µL OptiMEM (ExpiFectamine), 12.8 µL ExpiFectamine 293.

steps.title: Mix DNA with ExpiFectamine
steps.instruction: Combine the two plasmids in the DNA‑OptiMEM tube, mix gently. Dilute ExpiFectamine 293 in its OptiMEM tube, mix, and incubate 5 min at room temperature. Add the diluted ExpiFectamine to the DNA solution, mix gently, and incubate 10–20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add complexes to cells and incubate
steps.instruction: Add the DNA‑ExpiFectamine mixture dropwise to the diluted cells (2.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL) while swirling gently. Incubate the transfected cells for 48 h at 37 °C, 8 % CO₂, shaking at 125 rpm. (Optional: add enhancers the next day – not required).

steps.title: Count transfected cells for staining
steps.instruction: On day 3, count transfected (and mock‑transfected) cells, transfer 1.5× the calculated number to a 15 mL conical tube (e.g., ≥8.1 × 10⁶ cells).

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells in staining buffer
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with staining buffer (PBS + 1 % FBS), centrifuge 250 × g for 5 min, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend in at least ~600 µL staining buffer per 10⁶ cells (e.g., ~5 mL for 8.3 × 10⁶ cells) to obtain ~1.6 × 10⁷ cells/mL.

steps.title: Dilute cells to staining concentration
steps.instruction: Count cells, dilute to 1.2 × 10⁷ cells/mL in staining buffer, then perform a 20‑fold dilution (5 µL cells + 95 µL PBS) to reach ~8 × 10⁵ cells/mL. Verify viability with trypan blue as before.

steps.title: Prepare antibody serial dilutions
steps.instruction: In a fresh 96‑well plate (Plate A) add 120 µL staining buffer to wells A2‑A7 (and C2‑C7 for a second antibody). Add 150 µL of 600 nM antibody to well A1 (and C1). Perform a 5‑fold serial dilution across six wells by transferring 30 µL from the previous well, mixing >6 times each time.

substeps.instruction: Add 120 µL staining buffer to each dilution well.
Add 150 µL 600 nM antibody to the first well.
Transfer 30 µL to the next well, mix thoroughly, repeat through A7 (and C7).

steps.title: Combine cells and antibodies for staining
steps.instruction: Aliquot 25 µL of diluted cells (3 × 10⁵ cells) into each well of a second 96‑well plate (Plate B). Add 25 µL of the corresponding antibody dilution from Plate A to each well, mix gently, and incubate 1 h on ice.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with staining buffer (250 × g, 5 min), resuspend in 200 µL staining buffer, then add 50 µL of 1:250 goat anti‑human‑Fc‑PE (or equivalent) and incubate 1 h on ice. For cells‑only control, add 50 µL staining buffer instead of secondary.

steps.title: Final wash and prepare for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Wash twice with staining buffer, centrifuge 250 × g for 5 min, aspirate, and resuspend cells in staining buffer at a concentration suitable for the cytometer (e.g., ~1 × 10⁶ cells/mL). Keep on ice until acquisition.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run samples on a multicolor flow cytometer. Gate sequentially on FSC vs SSC (cell population), FSC‑A vs FSC‑H (singlets), and EGFP fluorescence (transfected cells). Collect at least 10 000 EGFP⁺ events, record PE (or secondary) fluorescence, and export geometric mean fluorescence intensity (GMFI) or median fluorescence intensity (MFI) for analysis.

steps.title: Transfect 293T cells with spike plasmids
steps.instruction: Seed 5 × 10⁵ 293T cells/mL in 4 mL 293T growth media in a T25 flask (day ‑1). On day 0, prepare DNA mix: 1 µg DNA per mL + 2 µL P3000 per mL in 50 µL OptiMEM per mL (for 4 mL → 4 µg DNA, 8 µL P3000, 200 µL OptiMEM). Prepare Lipofectamine 3000 mix: 2.5 µL Lipofectamine 3000 per mL in 50 µL OptiMEM per mL (for 4 mL → 10 µL Lipofectamine 3000, 200 µL OptiMEM). Combine DNA/P3000 with Lipofectamine 3000, incubate 10–15 min at RT, add dropwise to cells, and incubate overnight at 37 °C. Replace media with fresh 293T growth medium the next day.

steps.title: Prepare NK‑92 effector cells
steps.instruction: Thaw NK‑92 cells, culture in NK‑92 growth media with 500 U/mL human IL‑2 initially, then 250 U/mL for subsequent passages. Maintain density between 8 × 10⁴ and 3 × 10⁵ cells/mL, viability >95 %. One day after 293T transfection, centrifuge NK‑92 at 250 × g for 5 min, replace media with fresh NK‑92 media + 250 U/mL IL‑2, and incubate overnight at 37 °C. On assay day, count and resuspend in NK‑92 media without FBS at 2 × 10⁶ cells/mL.

steps.title: Detach and wash target 293T cells
steps.instruction: On assay day, remove media from 293T flasks and wash 2–3 times with PBS (4 mL for T25). Add PBS containing 10 mM EDTA (same volume), incubate ~10 min until cells detach (avoid trypsin). Collect cells, add 2–3 mL complete 293T growth media per mL original culture, transfer to a 15 mL tube, spin 250 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend in serum‑free 293T growth media. Repeat wash 2–3 times, ending with a suspension at ~1 × 10⁶ cells/mL.

steps.title: Load target cells with calcein‑AM
steps.instruction: Add calcein‑AM to the suspended 293T cells to a final concentration of 2 µM, invert several times, wrap the tube in foil, and incubate 30 min at 37 °C, inverting every ~10 min.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend calcein‑loaded cells
steps.instruction: Wash the calcein‑loaded cells three times with at least double the original culture volume of serum‑free 293T media (e.g., ≥8 mL for T25). Resuspend in serum‑free media, count, and dilute to 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL (10⁴ cells per 100 µL).

steps.title: Prepare antibody master mix for ADCC
steps.instruction: Prepare a 4× antibody stock in microcentrifuge tubes (e.g., for a final 50 nM concentration, make a 200 nM stock).

steps.title: Assemble ADCC assay plate
steps.instruction: In a 96‑well plate (Plate D) add 100 µL target cells (1 × 10⁴ cells) to each well. Add 50 µL antibody (or media for controls) to the appropriate wells. Add 50 µL NK‑92 cells (2 × 10⁶ cells/mL, 1 × 10⁵ cells) to all wells except the maximum‑lysis control. Controls: max lysis – 100 µL target cells only; NK‑92‑only – 50 µL NK‑92 + 150 µL media; spontaneous release – target + NK‑92 + 50 µL media; secondary‑only – not applicable here. Final volume per test well = 200 µL, giving 10:1 effector:target ratio and 50 nM antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL target cells to each well.
Add 50 µL NK‑92 cells where required.
Set up max‑lysis, NK‑92‑only, and spontaneous‑release controls.

steps.title: Incubate ADCC reactions
steps.instruction: Cover the plate with foil and incubate 4 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: After incubation, centrifuge the plate at 400 × g for 10 min. Transfer 100 µL supernatant from each well to a fresh black clear‑bottom 96‑well plate. Add 100 µL lysis buffer to the maximum‑lysis control wells, let sit 5–10 min at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Measure fluorescence and calculate lysis
steps.instruction: Measure fluorescence on a plate reader (excitation 488 nm, emission 515 nm). Calculate percent specific lysis using the formula: %Lysis = [(Sample – Spontaneous)/(Maximum – Spontaneous)] × 100.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol or parts of it has been used and validated in the following research article(s): Silva et al. [24]. Identification of a conserved S2 epitope present on spike proteins from all highly pathogenic coronaviruses. eLife. Effective antibody K D : Figure 4, panel e, ADCC: Figure 5, panel d. Each point was performed with 2–3 technical duplicates and each experiment was repeated 2–3 times. Antibody binding controls included a single stain with the control antibody S309 at 10 nM (maximum staining, data not shown) to determine spike display level. Validation of spike expression was performed using S309, also known as Sotrovimab, a well-characterized anti-spike antibody that is cross-reactive to SARS-CoV-2 variants and is known to have reduced binding to Omicron variants and no binding to MERS spike protein (Pinto et al. [28]).
